{{Top|leg}}
'''Piret Akarias''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who often visited [[Stronghold (planet)|Stronghold]]. Akarias was also the owner and operator of the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Meandering Star]]''. During the [[Battle of Stronghold|invasion of Stronghold]] by the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Charon/Legends|Charon]], Akarias fought with the Alliance defenders, but his small group of personnel was overwhelmed and captured. Akarias escaped but witnessed the horrors that the Charon inflicted upon their prisoners. Escaping to the hidden [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]], Akarias managed to launch his ship, the ''Meandering Star'', and escape the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
